description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for LPD880X LED strips, implementing SPI communication and LED control functions.

methods.name: lpd880x_update
methods.description: Updates the LED strip with new data via SPI.

methods.name: lpd880x_strip_update_rgb
methods.description: Converts RGB pixel data to strip-specific format and updates the strip.

methods.name: lpd880x_strip_update_channels
methods.description: Updates the LED strip with channel data.

methods.name: lpd880x_strip_init
methods.description: Initializes the LED strip device, checking SPI readiness.
